webui.signInBody: Kinopeer runs in qBittorrent’s Web UI: sign in with its username and password.
webui.signInFailed: qBittorrent didn’t sign you in. Try again.
webui.storeFull: qBittorrent’s store for web interfaces is full: it holds 1 MiB for all of them. Another interface used with this qBittorrent may have filled it.
webui.prowlarrStoreFull: Prowlarr’s address and key weren’t saved. $t(webui.storeFull)
webui.defaultsStoreFull: Changed in this browser only, until the page is reloaded. $t(webui.storeFull)
webui.tmdbKeyBody: Posters, search and metadata come from The Movie Database. Kinopeer’s own key works only when qBittorrent is opened at a local address, so here use a free API key (v3) or read access token of your own. Kinopeer keeps it in qBittorrent.
webui.tmdbKeyFieldHelp: Kept in qBittorrent, for every device that signs in to it.
webui.prowlarrSetupBody: Kinopeer finds releases through Prowlarr. Enter its address as this browser reaches it, and its API key. Without Prowlarr everything works but finding releases.
webui.prowlarrAddressHelp: As this browser reaches it, for example http://192.168.1.10:9696
webui.prowlarrKeyFieldHelp: Kept in qBittorrent: anyone who can sign in to it can read the key.
